claims.claim_ar: «ماذا» أداة استفهام (مركبة: ما + ذا) تستعمل للسؤال عن الشيء؛ في بعض سياقاتها التفسيرية تتّخذ نبرة تحضيض أو استفهام تقريري تختلف عن ترجمة إنجليزية واحدة عامة.
claims.claim_en: "mādhā" is an interrogative particle (historically analysable as ما + ذا). It asks 'what' but can carry pragmatic/nuance (e.g. rebuke, emphasis) that is often lost in simple translations.
claims.needs_review_reason: Claim about internal composition (ما + ذا) and pragmatic nuance is based on tafsir phrasing rather than a dedicated lexical source; verify with classical lexica.

claims.claim_en: "Allāh" is a proper noun from the root (هـ-ا-ه) meaning 'the God / the Lord'. It is a theonym (proper name) denoting divinity/ Lordship; exegetical context stresses attributes (power, hearing, knowledge).
